releases.title: A new dashboard
notes: Pholama now opens on a dashboard: newest version, what's new, newest models and your PC at a glance
The website and the PC app list the same 51 models (the website used to show only 7)
Chat is one tap away in the top bar
A release check makes sure the website and PC app always show the newest models and version

releases.title: Real tools and a local API
notes: 19 tools for the local AI, including safe file tools locked to one workspace folder
Every model is labelled Runs tools, Basic tools only or Chat only
Only models that really run tools are recommended (smallest: Llama 3.2 3B)
Ollama and OpenAI style local API for games and websites, with a docs page at /api/docs
New API guide and updated READMEs

releases.title: Studio builds on small models
notes: Guided build writes files itself so small models can build Studio projects
No more looping: old chatter is removed from history
Page skeleton repaired in code; bad auto-fixes rolled back

releases.title: Safer file edits
notes: Fixed edits that failed on Windows line endings
Edits now ignore indentation differences but keep your formatting
